Gramlot 0.2.6 publishes type declarations for the JavaScript package and leaves the examples to `gramlot-examples`.

## What changes

- The JavaScript package carries hand-written `.d.ts` declarations for its five entry points (`.`, `./server`, `./runtime`, `./page`, `./host`), referenced with `@ts-self-types`. Every entry point has a module doc and every exported symbol is documented; the README has a usage example. No runtime change.
- The browser runtime bundle `dist/gramlot.js` carries the same module doc and its `dist/gramlot.d.ts`.
- The dependencies require the versions that publish their own declarations: `@genrojs/bag` 0.10.3, `@genrojs/builders` 0.4.2, `@genrojs/tytx` 0.16.2.
- The example pages, their runner and the gallery are no longer part of the core: they are the package `gramlot-examples`, served by the gallery command of each environment. The JSR package no longer includes `examples/html_svg`.

## Upgrading from 0.2.5

- No change for pages, in Python or JavaScript.
- A project that read the examples from the core package reads them from `gramlot-examples`.
